workstream: Wave 3C-3 — Transport completeness from Makati publications
methodology: Official Makati inventory/count first; current operator verification second; implementation only after discrepancy classification.

substeps.title: Reconcile Makati transport inventories
substeps.scope: Official counts/named inventories vs current Civic Map; no implementation.

substeps.title: Reconcile the 32 current bus stops
substeps.scope: Find/verify named city stop inventory; research only before any implementation.

substeps.title: Reconcile historical jeepney routes
substeps.scope: Crosswalk 38 2020 route rows against current LTFRB/operator evidence and decide route-vs-terminal representation.
substeps.splitReason: Bound the 38-row historical route crosswalk into Ayala/Guadalupe and remaining-route batches.

substeps.title: Resolve PNR/NSCR lifecycle representation
substeps.scope: Decide how suspended PNR stations and future NSCR successors should appear without implying current service.

substeps.title: Close transport completeness audit
substeps.scope: Disposition every reviewed transport inventory item/family and validate the implemented current layer.

immediateNext.title: Resolve PNR/NSCR lifecycle representation
immediateNext.scope: Research/design only. Determine how suspended Dela Rosa, Pasay Road and EDSA PNR stations should appear, identify current/future NSCR station relationships without assuming one-to-one successors, and do not imply current PNR commuter service.
